msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a elegant Spanish woman in her fifties). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): An elegant Spanish woman in her fifties wearing a red cropped jacket with a voluminous royal blue taffeta midi skirt and long black gloves, on a plain warm beige background from the reference, walking at a street in the old town of Vitoria-Gasteiz, Spain, with stone buildings and glazed balconies, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a voluminous plum purple taffeta midi skirt with a white shirt with a big printed brown hare on it from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing an oversized ivory cocoon coat with a large painted tulip print in red and green from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of an emerald and black gingham check short shirt jacket (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a chunky statement necklace of large orange and black resin beads (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
